title: ctenopteris sikkimensis
intro: Ctenopteris sikkimensis, commonly known as Sikkim maidenhair, is a species of flowering plant in the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used in herbal remedies. The health benefits of Ctenopteris sikkimensis include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and improve overall well-being.
